title: termal_get_session_result accepts a bare delegation UUID and answers a misleading 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication" instead of resolving or refusing the id form
outcome: A delegation id given in the bare-UUID form either resolves to the same delegation as its canonical "delegation-<uuid>" form, or is refused with a typed error that names the expected id form; it never yields a misleading "no confirmed publication" or "delegation not found" answer for a delegation that exists and is published.
acceptance: The delegation tools that take a delegationId (at least termal_get_session_result and termal_get_session_status) either normalize a bare UUID to the canonical 'delegation-<uuid>' id or refuse it with a typed error naming the expected form, consistently across the MCP bridge and the HTTP route.

Tests show: the canonical id reads a published attempt; the bare UUID of the same delegation reads it too (if normalized) or gets the typed id-form refusal (if refused); a genuinely unknown id still gets its own not-found answer; and no path returns 'review attempt has no confirmed publication' for an existing, published attempt.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
